name: agentic-data-kernel
description: Temporal knowledge and durable workflow infrastructure for software agents

scripts.example: npm run build && node --no-warnings dist/cli.js example --db .data/example.db
scripts.serve: npm run build && node --no-warnings dist/cli.js serve --db .data/agentic.db
scripts.mcp: npm run build && node --no-warnings dist/cli.js mcp --db .data/agentic.db
scripts.prod:migrate: npm run build && node --env-file=.env dist/production/cli.js migrate
scripts.prod:status: npm run build && node --env-file=.env dist/production/cli.js migration-status
scripts.prod:serve: npm run build && node --env-file=.env dist/production/cli.js serve
scripts.prod:worker: npm run build && node --env-file=.env dist/production/cli.js worker
scripts.prod:mcp: npm run build && node --env-file=.env dist/production/cli.js mcp
scripts.prod:load: npm run build && node --env-file=.env dist/production/cli.js load
